projecthero.spin.ability.ball_breaker.de: Hold to charge like the Golden Spin. Only a Perfect Spin works: Ball Breaker, a lime armoured figure studded with magenta gems and crowned with two great discs, bursts out of the ball and strikes the creature you aim at (30 blocks) for 60 damage through armour, then ages it: Weakness II, Slowness III and Wither for 10 seconds. A release that isn't Perfect fails and costs 20 Spin. 100 Spin, 3 min cooldown.
